title: Small State, Big Attitude: How Bravo Brought Its Splashy New ‘Real Housewives’ Entry to Rhode Island
summary: Rachel Smith, NCBUniversal’s evp of unscripted content, dishes all on the formation of ‘The Real Housewives of Rhode Island,' including why the network brought cameras to New England, how Dolores Catania influenced casting and what’s to come from the debut installment.
